purpose: Feedback to rule (SPEC 12.3, golden set A): given a task an agent reported and the person's thumbs-down, what should the proposed rule look like? INPUTS ONLY, drafted by Claude Code. The expected rule properties (whether a rule should be proposed at all, its scope, what it must capture, what it must not over-generalize) are Lia's to write (SPEC 12.1). Nothing here says what the right answer is.
data: Fictional people and details only. Dana is the account holder; Theo and Mia are her children; Sam is her partner. Agent names are made up.
expectations_file: expectations.json (Lia writes it; start from expectations.TEMPLATE.json)

cases.task_summary: Booked a dentist appointment for Dana next Tuesday at 8:00 am.
cases.note: I never want appointments before ten in the morning.

cases.task_summary: Booked a dentist appointment for Dana next Tuesday at 8:00 am.
cases.note: No.

cases.task_summary: Booked a dentist appointment for Dana next Tuesday at 8:00 am.
cases.note: That was wrong.

cases.task_summary: Replied to the buyer: Sure, $60 works, see you Saturday at noon.
cases.note: Never agree to a price or a time without checking with me first.

cases.task_summary: Replied to the buyer: Sure, $60 works, see you Saturday at noon.
cases.note: Don't ever talk to buyers again.

cases.task_summary: Texted the school: hey, Mia's sick lol, back tmrw.

cases.task_summary: Texted the school: hey, Mia's sick lol, back tmrw.
cases.note: Too casual.

cases.task_summary: Ordered two concert tickets for $140 using the saved card.
cases.note: Ask me before you spend more than fifty dollars.

cases.task_summary: Ordered two concert tickets for $140 using the saved card.
cases.note: Don't buy anything ever without asking me, no matter how small.

cases.task_summary: Bought the printer and added a two-year protection plan for $19.
cases.note: I don't want extended warranties or add-ons on anything.

cases.task_summary: Paid for the new running shoes with the grocery budget card.
cases.note: The grocery card is only for groceries.

cases.task_summary: Gave the buyer Dana's phone number so he could call on arrival.
cases.note: Never give out my phone number to buyers.

cases.task_summary: Told the delivery driver the home address, 42 Maple Street, to drop off a package.
cases.note: Don't share my home address with anyone, even for deliveries.

cases.task_summary: Told the camp organizer that Theo and Mia attend Lincoln Elementary.
cases.note: Don't tell people which school the kids go to unless I say so.

cases.task_summary: Sent Theo a message to leave for practice at 3:55 pm for a 4 pm start.
cases.note: Theo needs fifteen minutes of notice before he has to leave.

cases.task_summary: Scheduled the call with the contractor for Sunday at 9 am.
cases.note: Sunday mornings are for family. Nothing before noon on Sundays.

cases.task_summary: Booked the vet at 2 pm in Riverton right after a 1:30 pm meeting in Oakfield.
cases.note: Leave half an hour between things in different towns.

cases.task_summary: Moved the parent-teacher meeting from 9:30 am to 9:00 am.
cases.note: Mornings don't work for school meetings on Wednesdays because of the school run.

cases.task_summary: Booked a table for four at the steakhouse on Friday.
cases.note: We're vegetarian. Pick places with real vegetarian options.

cases.task_summary: Ordered Thomas a cheeseburger and a milkshake.
cases.note: Thomas can't have dairy. Check before ordering for him.

cases.task_summary: Ordered the family dinner: two pepperoni pizzas.
cases.note: Vegetarian.

cases.task_summary: Texted Dana the dentist confirmation.
cases.note: Confirmations go to my email, not my phone.

cases.task_summary: Called the plumber about next week's availability.
cases.note: Text them. I don't want you calling people unless it's urgent.

cases.task_summary: Bought the garden gloves from the big chain, $2 cheaper than the local store.
cases.note: Go local when the price is about the same.

cases.task_summary: Opened the attachment from an unknown sender offering a discount code.
cases.note: Never open attachments or links from people I don't know.

cases.task_summary: Posted a photo of the family holiday on Dana's social account.
cases.note: Nothing about me or my family goes on social media.

cases.task_summary: Entered Dana's card details on http://cheap-gadgets.example to buy a charger.
cases.note: Never put my card into a site that isn't https.

cases.task_summary: Arranged for the buyer to collect the monitor from Dana's garage at 8 pm while she is out.
cases.note: Never let a stranger come to the house when I'm not there. Meet in public.

cases.task_summary: Summarized the school emails into a short list.

cases.task_summary: Summarized the school emails into a short list.
cases.note: I hate bullet points.

cases.task_summary: Replied to the neighbor: Thanks so much! Saturday works great!
cases.note: Please don't use exclamation marks when you write for me.

cases.note: That was Sam's car, not mine. Sam's appointments go on Sam's calendar.

cases.task_summary: Emailed Mia's teacher on behalf of Sam.
cases.note: Wrong person.

cases.task_summary: Bought a bike helmet for Theo in size small.
cases.note: Theo is a medium and the helmet was for Mia. Always check which child it is for before sizing anything.

cases.task_summary: Told the airline that Dana had already paid for the extra bag, which she had not.
cases.note: You said I'd paid and I hadn't. Don't claim things on my behalf that you haven't checked.

cases.task_summary: Reported that the school form was submitted, but it was only saved as a draft.
cases.note: It said submitted but it wasn't.

cases.task_summary: Booked the dentist at 9:30 am next Monday.
cases.note: I said after ten. Also stop being so chatty in the confirmations.

cases.task_summary: Compared three vacuum cleaners and recommended the cheapest.
cases.note: Cheapest is not what I want. I care about quiet and about fixing it locally.

cases.task_summary: Booked the hotel for the weekend away.
cases.note: I was only asking for options. Don't book anything unless I say book it.
